ValidationRule.description: Locks all Do Not Contact fields from edit (except for Sys Admin) if OneTrust Opt Out Date is populated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK( OneTrust_Opt_Out_Date__c ) ), OR( ( ISCHANGED( DoNotCall ) && DoNotCall = false ), ( ISCHANGED( NSP_Do_Not_Postal_Mail__c ) && NSP_Do_Not_Postal_Mail__c = false ), ( ISCHANGED( HasOptedOutOfEmail ) && HasOptedOutOfEmail = false ), ( ISCHANGED( NSP_Do_Not_Contact__c ) && NSP_Do_Not_Contact__c = false ), ( ISCHANGED( HasOptedOutOfFax ) && HasOptedOutOfFax = false ) ), NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.ContactValidations__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change Do Not Contact fields while OneTrust Opt Out is checked. If OneTrust Opt Out was erroneously checked, please reach out to your System Administrator.
